what: Ops token (WORK_STORE_TOKEN) rotation, every 90 days (operator popup ~21:44Z 2026-11-12, verbatim: "Every 90 days", relayed by Manager Session 2026-11-11a). When due, the manager dispatches ONE lane that runs docs/runbooks/ops-token-rotation.md: stage-token-rotation ops job (VM side, dual-accept 72 h), then the ONE operator prompt (request_credential for ict-bot.duckdns.org header X-Work-Store-Token + paste the same value into the GitHub secret WORK_STORE_TOKEN), then sync-vm-secrets, verify, ledger-backfill. After a successful rotation the lane re-dates last_checked (pipeline.py --redate). Recurring: never closed by a rotation. No cron by design.
